add_record.description: Add a record through a form. Files are added afterwards with 'Upload file'.
add_record.name: add_record

parameters.description: The application. Pick it, or type owner/link_name (for example jason18/zylker-store) or paste its address.
parameters.name: application

parameters.description: The form. Pick it, or type its link name.
parameters.name: form

parameters.description: The value for each field to set. Fields left blank are not sent.
parameters.name: data

parameters.description: Optional. Link names of fields whose saved values to return with the record ID.
parameters.name: return_fields

parameters.description: Optional. Workflows not to run for this change. Only the application's administrators and developers can skip them.
parameters.name: skip_workflow

data.description: The ID, plus any fields asked for in 'Return fields'.

tasks.description: What the form's workflow asked to happen next, if anything.

add_records.description: Add up to 200 records through a form in one call. Records Zoho refuses are listed under 'failed' with the reason.

parameters.description: The application. Pick it, or type owner/link_name (for example jason18/zylker-store) or paste its address.

parameters.name: return_fields

parameters.description: Optional. Workflows not to run for this change. Only the application's administrators and developers can skip them.

failed.description: The records that failed, with the reason.

data.description: The ID, plus any fields asked for in 'Return fields'.

tasks.description: What the form's workflow asked to happen next, if anything.

delete_record.description: Delete one record through a report. This cannot be undone.

parameters.description: The application. Pick it, or type owner/link_name (for example jason18/zylker-store) or paste its address.
parameters.name: application

parameters.description: The report the records are read through. Pick it, or type its link name.
parameters.name: report

delete_records.description: Delete every record of a report that matches the criteria (up to 200 per run). This cannot be undone.

parameters.description: The application. Pick it, or type owner/link_name (for example jason18/zylker-store) or paste its address.
parameters.name: application

parameters.description: The report the records are read through. Pick it, or type its link name.
parameters.name: report

parameters.description: Which records, written with field link names, e.g. Status == "Open" && Total > 250. Use ID != 0 for every record.
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.description: Optional. When more than 200 records match, handle the first 200 and report more_records, instead of failing. Run the step again for the rest.
parameters.name: process_until_limit

parameters.description: Optional. Don't run the form's workflows for this deletion. Only the application's administrators and developers can skip them.
parameters.name: skip_form_workflow

failed.description: The records that failed, with the reason.

tasks.description: What the form's workflow asked to happen next, if anything.

more_records.description: Whether more records match: run the step again to process them.
